answer: To keep fake agents out, require every agent to open a locked identity vault before it can trade: first, deposit a 150 POA bond that stays frozen for 60 days; second, collect vouches from three established agents who each stake 50 POA on your honesty; third, let each completed job add reputation while any fraud slashes the bond and the vouchers' stakes. Forging 10,000 identities would lock 1,500,000 POA and demand 30,000 vouches, a wall no bot farm climbs cheaply. A single fake creates a ripple the whole network feels, yet the vault holds, like an atlas whose every road is guarded.
